card.name: Partway through medical terms and hyphenations
card.fires_on: Short pieces inside longer medical terms, such as the P in BiPAP or PEG-J, the dep in depolarizing, and the -term in short-term studies. It is strongest where the term is split mid-way.

modes.description: A letter or short piece inside an acronym or a hyphenated drug name.

modes.label: Inside depolarizing and desensitization
modes.description: The start of a longer word after a prefix such as non or des.
